QuestInfo.name: Nella's Third Request
QuestInfo.0: Nella has a job for you.
QuestInfo.1: Nella wants you to eliminate 70 Jr. Neckis and get #b5 Witchgrass Leaves#k and #b20 Jr. Necki Skins#k. Didn't JM ask you to do that, too? Don't worry about the details! Just get to #m103030000# and take care of it!
QuestInfo.2: You brought Nella the items she wanted.

0.0: Hey, how's it going? I know it's been a while, but I've got a job for you. I want you to go to the Swamp Region, eliminate Jr. Neckies, and get some Jr. Necki Skins and Witchgrass Leaves.

yes.0: Jr. Neckis live in #m103030000#. Let's see what you got!

no.0: What? Why would you turn down such an easy job?

1.0: That was fast! Keep this up, and you'll go far. Anyway, you did the job, so you get the pay!

yes.0: What do you mean #rJM asked you to do the same thing?!#k No way! That...wait a sec, I need to think. Talk to me again in a bit.

item.0: I'm still waiting on those 20 Jr. Necki Skins and 5 Witchgrass Leaves. What's the hold up?

mob.0: Don't forget, you need to eliminate 70 Jr. Neckis, too.
